tasks.title: Consolidate Satohash design tokens and style system
tasks.description: Create a unified design token layer for colors, typography, spacing, borders, shadows, and focus states in src/index.css.
steps: Audit the current tokens and remove dead alias variables
Define semantic base tokens for background, surface, text, border, accent, success, danger, and focus
Add accessible contrast token variants for hover, focus, disabled, and soft states
Document the design token set in a shared style reference
acceptance: No design token aliases remain inconsistent
Primary text and controls use semantic tokens
All primary text and CTA colors meet WCAG AA

tasks.title: Simplify navigation and improve flow
tasks.description: Trim the shell navigation to core journeys, surface the main path, and reduce information density on desktop and mobile.
steps: Identify the core flows: Vault, Stamp, Verify, Atlas
Reduce left rail and mobile nav items to the essentials
Hide advanced/secondary options behind a compact panel or secondary menu
Ensure the mobile bottom nav is clear, touch-friendly, and not overloaded
acceptance: Primary navigation contains no more than 5 top items
Secondary actions are hidden or collapsed by default
Mobile nav uses large tap areas and only highest-value routes

tasks.title: Improve typography scale and visual breathing room
tasks.description: Raise readable text sizes, add consistent spacing tokens, and reduce visual crowding in cards, headers, and lists.
steps: Replace tiny text sizes with a clearer scale (12px minimum for body copy)
Increase line-height and spacing around cards, sections, and nav groups
Reduce all-caps microcopy where it hurts readability
Ensure headings and sections have clear hierarchy and visual separation
acceptance: Body copy is readable on desktop and mobile
Sections have clear visual separation without extra noise
Typography feels consistent across the main user flows

tasks.title: Add thin illuminated frames to buttons and cards
tasks.description: Update the visual treatment for cards and buttons so they feel premium, sharp, and easy to scan.
steps: Create a thin lit frame style for primary cards and panels
Refine button styling with a premium border, subtle glow, and defined variants
Ensure buttons have at least 44px tap areas and crisp labels
Apply the new framed styles consistently to cards on the vault, stamp, and dashboard pages
acceptance: Cards have a polished frame and reduced surface noise
Buttons are visually distinct with clear hierarchy
Framed surfaces read as elevated and premium

tasks.title: Surface theme switching and polish dark/light balance
tasks.description: Make the theme toggle obvious, persist theme preference, and ensure both themes feel equally refined.
steps: Expose the ThemeToggle in the shell top bar or header
Persist theme choice in local storage and respect system preference
Audit the light theme for contrast and polish
Ensure the dark theme remains sharp with clear information flow
acceptance: Users can switch theme from the main shell
Both themes are balanced and readable
